products.name: Signing Package Readiness
products.product: A focused notary signing appointment package readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent notary signing services and mobile loan-signing coordinators
products.problem: Appointment contacts, location, document package, printing instructions, signer requirements, scanbacks, deadlines, fees, and notary acceptance arrive in fragments.
products.valueProposition: Turns notary signing appointment package readiness into a visible operating queue so every accepted signing starts with a complete current package, confirmed appointment, instructions, and return plan.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
